name: Celadon City Exploration & Department Store
summary: Exploring the commercial capital of Kanto. Stock up on Evolution Stones and TMs at the 5-story Celadon Department Store. Claim the free rooftop gift Eevee in Celadon Mansion, obtain the Coin Case in the Café, and accept or monitor active Team Rocket side contracts.

items.name: Eevee Gift
items.method: Enter Celadon Mansion through the rear back alley and climb to the rooftop penthouse room

items.name: Coin Case
items.method: Given by the patron in the Celadon Café during the day

items.name: Skull Fossil or Armor Fossil
items.method: Reward from Super Nerd Miguel in Celadon Café after defeat

items.name: TM81 X-Scissor
items.method: At the southern end of the small forested park in Celadon City

items.name: Super Splicers
items.method: Gift from the female trainer in the house adjacent to the Café

missables.name: Supplying the New Grunts
missables.warning: Team Rocket recruitment mission. Must catch 4 Pokémon in Celadon outskirts using Rocket Balls before defeating Gym 8 / Mt. Ember.

missables.name: Interception!
missables.warning: Celadon Department Store TM shipment heist. Deliver counterfeit TMs to earn a choice of Ice Beam, Thunderbolt, or Flamethrower before Gym 8 / Mt. Ember.
